fields.name: schema_version
fields.canonical_form: Integer, monotonic. An envelope of an unrecognised version is refused, never coerced.

fields.name: authorization_id
fields.canonical_form: auth:<uuid-v4>. Immutable identity of the authorization itself.

fields.name: action_kind
fields.canonical_form: Closed enum, exact case: merge, staging_write, production_write, destructive_operation, policy_weakening, waive_finding.

fields.name: project_id
fields.canonical_form: prj:<uuid-v4>, orchestrator-internal immutable identity.

fields.name: lane_id
fields.canonical_form: lane:<uuid-v4>.

fields.name: task_id
fields.canonical_form: task:<uuid-v4>.

fields.name: wait_id
fields.canonical_form: wait:<uuid-v4> — the gate episode the request belongs to (INV-A7).

fields.name: decision_id
fields.canonical_form: dec:<uuid-v4> — the specific answered decision row.

fields.name: target_identity
fields.canonical_form: Scheme-tagged immutable identity; see spec/07-identity.md. Never a display name.

fields.name: repository_identity
fields.canonical_form: repo:<provider>:<provider-immutable-id>. The display slug is stored beside it and is never authoritative.

fields.name: pr_number
fields.canonical_form: Positive integer, scoped by repository_identity.

fields.name: base_sha
fields.canonical_form: Full 40-character hex, lowercased. Lowercasing is lossless here because Git object names are hexadecimal; a branch name is never accepted in this field.

fields.name: head_sha
fields.canonical_form: As base_sha.

fields.name: artifact_digest
fields.canonical_form: sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.

fields.name: effect_parameters_digest
fields.canonical_form: sha256 over the versioned canonical serialization of the effect parameter object. Binds what is executed, not merely that something is.

fields.name: policy_revision
fields.canonical_form: sha256 over the versioned canonical serialization of the policy document in force at issuance.

fields.name: evidence_snapshot_ref
fields.canonical_form: sha256 over the sorted, newline-joined content digests of the evidence observations relied on; see spec/03-evidence.md.

fields.name: outcome
fields.canonical_form: APPROVED, DENIED or CANCELLED. Never defaulted, never inferred from lifecycle state. Only APPROVED is redeemable.

fields.name: issuer
fields.canonical_form: principal:<uuid-v4> — the authenticated principal that granted it. The field records authority, it does not confer it.

fields.name: recipient
fields.canonical_form: principal:<uuid-v4> — the only principal that may redeem it.

fields.name: issued_at
fields.canonical_form: RFC 3339 UTC with Z, from the authoritative clock. Never used as a uniqueness source.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.canonical_form: As issued_at; strictly greater than it.

fields.name: use_limit
fields.canonical_form: Positive integer. Its disposition is stated per action kind and is never inferred.

fields.name: justification
fields.canonical_form: Free text, length-bounded, included in envelope_digest.

fields.name: envelope_digest
fields.canonical_form: sha256 over the versioned canonical serialization of all 24 preceding fields. An integrity and identity digest only: never a signature, a MAC, or a proof of authority.

field_groups.name: git_provenance
field_groups.rule: All-or-nothing with a required core. Supplying none of the four is permitted. Supplying any of the four requires repository_identity, base_sha and head_sha together; pr_number may be supplied only when repository_identity is present. An isolated head, base or PR number is refused.

merge.title: Merge a reviewed tuple
merge.notes: A merge acts on a ref, not on a built artifact, so artifact_digest is forbidden.

staging_write.title: Write to a staging environment
staging_write.notes: The only kind with a caller-chosen use count; it must be stated explicitly as a positive integer and is never defaulted. Git provenance is optional as a group, not field by field.

production_write.title: Write to production
production_write.notes: Git provenance is optional as a group; when present it is bound like any other field.

destructive_operation.title: Irreversible operation on a resource
destructive_operation.notes: The target is a resource, not a ref: an isolated head, base or PR number cannot arise here because all three are forbidden.

policy_weakening.title: Weaken a policy or a gate
policy_weakening.notes: policy_revision names the revision being weakened. Weakening a gate is justified by a decision, never by evidence, so evidence_snapshot_ref is forbidden. The target is an immutable policy id; a key path or display name is never authoritative.

waive_finding.title: Waive one finding on one tuple
waive_finding.notes: A waiver is precisely the absence of clearing evidence, so evidence_snapshot_ref is forbidden.
